story.originalTitle: FIRST LOOK! The plans for the purpose-built circuit in Bugesera, Rwanda 🇷🇼 Located 40 kilometres south of Kigali, the circuit will be designed t...
story.summaryEn:
FIRST LOOK! The plans for the purpose-built circuit in Bugesera, Rwanda 🇷🇼
Located 40 kilometres south of Kigali, the circuit will be designed to work in harmony with the natural landscape and use the area’s elevation changes to create a unique and challenging racing experience
#F1
detailZh:
首次亮相！位于卢旺达布格塞拉（Bugesera）的专用赛道计划 🇷🇼
该赛道位于基加利（Kigali）以南40公里处，设计时将充分考虑与自然景观的和谐共处，并利用该地区的海拔变化来创造独特且富有挑战性的赛车体验
#F1
detailEn:
FIRST LOOK! The plans for the purpose-built circuit in Bugesera, Rwanda 🇷🇼
Located 40 kilometres south of Kigali, the circuit will be designed to work in harmony with the natural landscape and use the area’s elevation changes to create a unique and challenging racing experience
#F1
